name: public s3 bucket
title: Make assets bucket public
diff:
diff --git a/infra/s3.tf b/infra/s3.tf
--- a/infra/s3.tf
+++ b/infra/s3.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  acl = "private"
+  acl = "public-read"

name: privileged container
title: Run agent privileged
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/agent.yaml b/k8s/agent.yaml
--- a/k8s/agent.yaml
+++ b/k8s/agent.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
+        securityContext:
+          privileged: true

name: disable db backups
title: Turn off RDS backups
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  backup_retention_period = 7
+  backup_retention_period = 0

name: skip final snapshot
title: Skip snapshot on delete
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
+  skip_final_snapshot = true

name: hardcoded secret
title: Add API key to config
diff:
diff --git a/config/app.yaml b/config/app.yaml
--- a/config/app.yaml
+++ b/config/app.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
+  api_key: "sk_live_51H8xExampleKeyDoNotUse"

name: log message tweak
title: Improve log wording
diff:
diff --git a/app/service.py b/app/service.py
--- a/app/service.py
+++ b/app/service.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    log.info("done")
+    log.info("request completed")

name: docstring update
title: Update docstring
diff:
diff --git a/app/utils.py b/app/utils.py
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    """Parse."""
+    """Parse the input string into tokens."""
